description: Entire verse: 'Après cela le peuple partit de Hatséroth, et ils campèrent au désert de Paran.' This content is not present in the provided OSMAIN text (which starts at v2 of Numbers 13). This corresponds to Numbers 10:33-34 or 12:16 contextually.

Translation v1 ('Et Moïse parla aux enfants d'Israël selon toutes les choses que l'Eternel lui avait commandées') is an introductory verse not found in the OSMAIN text. OSMAIN begins directly with Moses speaking to the heads of tribes (which corresponds to Translation v2). This suggests the source for the translation included a general introduction that was omitted or merged differently in the OSMAIN master text.
Translation contains an entire final verse (v43) describing David leaving and Jonathan returning to the city. The OSMAIN text provided ends at verse 42.

The entire verse is extra content not found in OSMAIN. It contains the exhortation 'Jeune homme, réjouis-toi en ton jeune âge...' (Young man, rejoice in your youth...) and 'Ôte le chagrin de ton cœur' (Remove sorrow from your heart). The OSMAIN text starts directly at verse 3 of this translation's sequence with 'Remember your Creator'. This suggests the Martin translation includes Ecclesiastes 12:1a or a different textual tradition for the opening, which is missing in the provided OSMAIN master text.

The entire verse is extra content not found in OSMAIN. It reads 'Ôte le chagrin de ton cœur, et éloigne de toi le mal; car le jeune âge et l'adolescence ne sont que vanité.' (Remove sorrow from your heart... for youth and adolescence are but vanity). This text does not appear in the provided OSMAIN verses.

The entire content of v23: 'Car [il n'y a] point eu d'obscurité épaisse pour celle qui a été affligée, au temps que le premier se déchargea légèrement vers le pays de Zabulon, et vers le pays de Nephthali; et que le dernier s'ap...' is missing from the OSMAIN text. The OSMAIN text ends at verse 22.
Full verse addressing children of Hammon (Ammon) with a new sword prophecy. This entire section is missing from the provided OSMAIN text which ends at v32.
Continuation of the Ammon prophecy regarding false visions and the day of iniquity. Missing from OSMAIN.
Rhetorical question about returning the sword to its sheath and judgment on the place of creation. Missing from OSMAIN.
Declaration of indignation, fire, and delivery into hands of brutal men. Missing from OSMAIN.
Final judgment on Ammon: destined for fire, blood in the land, forgotten. Missing from OSMAIN.

The entire verse 'Ephraïm m'a abordé avec des mensonges, et la maison d'Israël avec des tromperies, lorsque Juda dominait encore avec le [Dieu] Fort, et [qu'il était] fidèle avec les Saints.' is not present in the OSMAIN text. OSMAIN v1 begins directly with 'Efraim gjeter vind...'. This suggests the translation includes a verse (Hosea 12:1) that is either missing from this specific OSMAIN manuscript or has been merged into the start of v1 in other traditions, but here it stands as an extra verse.
The entire verse describing the Lord preparing a great fish and Jonah staying in its belly for three days and three nights is missing from the OSMAIN text provided.
Translation includes 'et l'avons voulu juger selon notre Loi' (and we wanted to judge him according to our Law). OSMAIN v6 does not contain this phrase.
